title: Corrects repeated words throughout the code.
description:
Repeated words were found with:
egrep "(\b[a-zA-Z]+) +\1\b" . -Ir
and then manually reviewed.
Non-displayed strings (e.g., in comments)
were also corrected, to ease future review.

notes.body:
added 3 commits
  • 076cc264...4a7053e8 - 2 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 841dad3b - Corrects repeated words throughout the code.
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5512/diffs?diff_id=298996106&start_sha=076cc26449aceb3adcc9dc205eee6ddfe55a62c3)
I'm not sure we should change/fix ASN taken directly from specifications.  In this case it doesn't result in any generated code difference.
As Martin said, please do not modify external files like ASN.1 ones that are extracted from the specifications and will be overwritten next time.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5512/diffs?diff_id=299404250&start_sha=841dad3bf4a274b0c88ff4b1672adb7044e1ae19#18571ba09c5e2c7e00dcf145ff741e9f35411cab_12912_12911)
Thank you both. I removed the changes to .asn files. Can you please rereview?

commits_data.title: Corrects repeated words throughout the code.
commits_data.message:
Corrects repeated words throughout the code.

Repeated words were found with:
egrep "(\b[a-zA-Z]+) +\1\b" . -Ir
and then manually reviewed.
Non-displayed strings (e.g., in comments)
were also corrected, to ease future review.
